purpose: Convert the extrapolation into MEASUREMENT. audio-and-stt.md requires budgeting from measured duration, never from a planning estimate.

MEASURED_TOTALS.rate: USD 0.0043/min - the CUT30-era rate. NOT re-derived or negotiated for this corpus.
MEASURED_TOTALS.status: FORECAST FROM MEASURED DURATION. Actual spend is a separate number and is not yet observed.

THE_FINDING_THAT_BREAKS_THE_EFFICIENCY_P.statement: MP3s DO NOT EXIST for the earlier material. They begin at 2023/10.
THE_FINDING_THAT_BREAKS_THE_EFFICIENCY_P.consequence: 265.73 h - 50.3% of all corpus audio - exists ONLY as MP4. For that half the 'skip the video entirely' shortcut does NOT apply: the MP4 must be downloaded and its audio extracted with ffmpeg. The bandwidth saving therefore applies to roughly half the corpus, not all of it.
THE_FINDING_THAT_BREAKS_THE_EFFICIENCY_P.this_corrects: An earlier statement that 'the MP3s already exist, so no video download is needed'. That was true only of the recent material and was over-generalised from 2025 samples.

STRUCTURAL_DEFECT_FOUND.statement: Folder nesting depth is NOT uniform. Some month folders contain further subfolders rather than files.
STRUCTURAL_DEFECT_FOUND.instance: 2024/06_07 contained no files at all - it contained '6. June & July 2024' (16.44 GB), which itself contained '6. June - 2024' (11.13 GB) and '7. July - 2024' (5.31 GB). Sizes reconcile: 11.13 + 5.31 = 16.44.
STRUCTURAL_DEFECT_FOUND.impact: The first sweep recorded this folder as zero files - a FALSE ZERO indistinguishable from an empty folder. Recovering it added 28.01 h (10 MP3s, 9 PDFs) to the corpus total.
STRUCTURAL_DEFECT_FOUND.why_it_matters: 'Zero rows' and 'not a leaf' are different facts. A sweep that cannot tell them apart will silently under-report.

RESIDUAL_RISK_NOT_CLOSED.statement: Only folders yielding ZERO files were re-examined for subfolders. A folder containing BOTH files and subfolders would have been counted by file alone, with its subfolders never visited.
RESIDUAL_RISK_NOT_CLOSED.status: NOT CHECKED. 35 folders would need a subfolder-detection pass.
RESIDUAL_RISK_NOT_CLOSED.direction_of_error: Under-reporting only. The true total is >= 528.35 h. It cannot be lower.

LOWER_BOUND_CAVEAT.statement: Every folder reported scrolls=1, i.e. the virtualised list converged after a single scroll. If that single scroll under-loaded, file and duration counts are floors.
LOWER_BOUND_CAVEAT.counter_evidence: 2025/01 and 2025/02 returned the highest counts in the sweep (35 files each) and matched an independent earlier read closely, so scrolling did materialise additional rows. 2024/01 returned identical numbers across two independent methods (4 mp3 / 15.07 h / 0 pdf), confirming convergence for that folder.
LOWER_BOUND_CAVEAT.status: Partially corroborated, not proven for all 37 folders.

ANOMALY_CARRIED_FORWARD.statement: 2025/02 contains an MP3 whose rendered duration is '00:00' while its MP4 sibling shows a real duration. Cause NOT RECORDED. This is precisely the shape a duration gate must catch: a plausible file whose content is absent.

SCOPE_NOTE.ai_summaries: 51 'AI Summary' PDFs exist in-corpus. They are a FREE written register requiring no LLM spend. They are AI-generated, not authored course material, and must never be presented as the instructor's words.
SCOPE_NOTE.transcription_required: Only the 85 MP3s and the audio of the 183 MP4s. 51 PDFs need no transcription at all.
